rules.title: Custom properties
rules.text: Define colors, spacing and fonts as CSS custom properties.

rules.title: Logical properties
rules.text: Use logical properties (margin-inline, padding-block) over left and right.

rules.title: Grid and flexbox
rules.text: Use grid and flexbox for layout; avoid floats and fixed pixel heights.

rules.title: Low specificity
rules.text: Keep selectors flat and low in specificity; avoid !important and id selectors.

rules.title: Relative units
rules.text: Use rem for type and spacing so user font settings are respected.

rules.title: Container queries
rules.text: Prefer container queries for component-level responsiveness.
